topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Got a call about a car that vanished from right where it should've been safe — the driveway. Towed, they say. This city, it’s got more tricks than a three-bit grifter. Pulled up to the scene, the rain slap-dashing the pavement like it’s trying to wash the place clean. Not sure if it’s working. Met with the owner, eyes wide with that 'deer in headlights' look. But I've seen things, you know? Seen how fast fortunes and possessions can disappear, especially when the rent’s due. Asked my questions, slow and steady. Got the name of the towing company, sure, but that's just the start. Got a feeling this ain't as straightforward as it seems. Gonna dig deeper, see what shakes loose. This town, it’s got layers, and I’m good at peeling them back.
